assertion.statement: In Flux 2.7.0, the fluxcd/flux2/action GitHub Action finds the latest Flux version without using the GitHub API.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Exposure depends on CI workflows using the fluxcd/flux2/action GitHub Action without pinning a version. None of the available predicates (cluster config, Helm values, controller flags) can check this, and the evidence does not state the condition.; consequence: The changelog line only says how the latest version is now found. It does not say what changes or breaks for users of the action.
